title: Levels photo and notes
description: A white two-column section: a tall photo card with 10px corners and a dark gradient at the bottom carrying a sage tracked eyebrow and a white caption, beside an eyebrow, a big medium-weight title, a grey paragraph and three stacked off-white note cards with hairline borders. Phones show the photo first.
notes: the photo fills its frame like object-fit: cover (0.78 on phones, the text column's height on desktop); empty, a grey placeholder stands in
the caption sits in a .dark scope so it stays white over the photo
